title: Native star extraction reads an uninitialized count after detector failure
summary: A valid1x1 RAW with downsample2 becomes a zero-sized normalized image; filtered_image returnsNULL and the common detector rejects geometry without writing stars_found. The wrapper leaves that local uninitialized, ignores the FAILED result and uses it as a loop bound, potentially exceeding capacity-sized arrays. Initialize count, honor detector failure, validate returned count and reject zero post-bin geometry; add a tiny valid frame/downsample2 error-path regression. Two independent source traces confirmed; no unsafe image execution or exploit claim. Next: coordinator assigns focused remediation and relevant verification.
evidence: indigo_drivers/agent_platesolver/indigo_solver.c:588-619,793,819-830; indigo_libs/indigo_raw_utils.c:2649,3101; components/native-platesolver.md NP05; components/core-image.md CI01; components/security-review.md
